reapack.name: PAGER
reapack.desc: Roland GS editor suite for REAPER
reapack.description:
{\rtf1\ansi\deff0 {\fonttbl{\f0 Segoe UI;}} \fs20 {\b PAGER}\line A suite of Roland GS editors for REAPER, aimed at the SC-8850 and its relatives.\par
One action opens a launcher, and the launcher opens one tool at a time. Every tool previews on the hardware as you edit and writes MIDI events only when you ask it to, so auditioning a value and committing it stay separate.\par
{\b Part Editor}\line Edits one Part at a time, chosen by the active MIDI editor's piano-roll channel, with the port group taken from the track's hardware output. Level, pan and the sends; cutoff and resonance; the envelope and vibrato rows; tuning offset, fine tune, pitch key and bend range; EQ and portamento.\par
Values can be written as native CC and RPN or as Roland SysEx, switchable per channel. Insert writes the last parameter you touched at the edit cursor, replacing its previous value rather than stacking a second one, and labels it in the take so the item says what it holds.\par
{\b Effects Editor}\line Master controls, the EQ and insertion-effect blocks, the reverb, chorus and delay parameters, and the per-Part EFX and EQ assignments. Presets can be saved and recalled, and an Insert can write a complete state or only the parameters you changed.\par
{\b MIDI Export}\line Writes the active take out as a standard MIDI file.\par
Values are remembered for the rest of the REAPER session, separately per project tab, and are never written into the project file.\par
Requires ReaImGui. MIDI Export additionally requires MIDIUtils.\par }

version.author: PurpBatBoi
version.changelog: Part Editor. - Edits one SC-8850 Part, selected by the MIDI editor's piano-roll channel; the track's hardware output selects the port group. - Sends and mix, filter, envelope, tuning, vibrato, and the switch and performance controls, in two columns. - Native CC/RPN or Roland SysEx encoding, switchable per channel. EQ, Pitch Key and Tuning Offset always use SysEx, having no CC form; Portamento always uses CC, having no musical-state SysEx field. - A settled edit previews on the hardware and becomes that channel's one pending value; Insert writes it at the edit cursor and sends nothing. - Insert replaces the parameter's previous representation rather than stacking a second one, across a change of encoding, and writes a readable text event beside it. - Control values and the SysEx setting are kept per channel and per project tab.
